items.reason: The initial interim RFS benefit was not sustained on updated analysis (updated RFS HR 1.26, 95% CI 0.85–1.87); the NCCN HCC Version 2.2026 Insights states that the recommendation was subsequently removed and that there is no adjuvant strategy at this time.
items.action: Retain the initial and updated reports together as one study; use as contrary/withdrawn-recommendation evidence in a dedicated review, not as a new trial page.

items.reason_deferred: Phase 3 result did not establish a metastasis-free or overall-survival benefit from adding enzalutamide to standard ADT plus radiotherapy; subgroup findings should not be promoted as a general standard.
items.next_action: Verify the exact trial registry/protocol identifier and extract the full primary efficacy/safety tables; map only if needed to interpret an active recommendation.

items.registry_status: Not verified in the accessible primary abstract; do not infer an ACTRN/UMIN identifier.
items.reason_deferred: BCG plus mitomycin did not demonstrate a statistically significant disease-free-survival advantage over BCG alone in the primary analysis. The possible reduction in BCG exposure is a treatment-burden signal, not proof of superior disease control.
items.next_action: Retrieve the full protocol/registry and detailed primary tables; retain as contrary evidence for BCG-sparing decisions.
